name: 左右對半：左側直式圖片＋右側置中文字
desc: 畫面左右對半，左半部是貼齊邊緣的直式圖片，右半部純色背景上垂直置中放大標題、說明文字和按鈕；底緣有一條分隔線。
prompt: 主視覺左右對半分成兩欄。左欄是一張直式圖片，佔畫面寬的一半，貼齊主視覺的上緣、下緣與畫面左緣，右緣在畫面正中央。右欄是純色背景，文字欄在右欄內垂直置中、水平置中，文字也置中對齊：大標題（可多行），約佔右欄寬的六成。標題下方可放說明文字與一個按鈕，由上往下排列，沒有內容時省略，標題位置不變。主視覺底緣有一條橫跨整個畫面寬的分隔線。
mobile: 左右兩欄改為上下排列：圖片在上，橫跨整個畫面寬，貼齊主視覺上緣與左右兩側，仍為直式裁切；大標題、說明文字與按鈕在圖片下方，水平置中、文字置中對齊。高度改為依內容而定，不再撐滿一個畫面。底緣的分隔線保留。沒有動態。

en.name: Half-and-half split: portrait image left, centered text right
en.desc: The viewport is split in half: the left half is a portrait image flush with the edges, and the right half holds a headline, description and button vertically centered on a plain background; a divider runs along the bottom edge.
en.prompt: The hero is split into two equal columns. The left column is a single portrait image taking half the viewport width, flush with the top and bottom edges of the hero and the left edge of the viewport, with its right edge at the exact center of the viewport. The right column has a plain solid background; the text column is vertically centered and horizontally centered within it, with the text center-aligned: a headline (may wrap to multiple lines) about sixty percent of the right column's width. Optionally place a description and a button below the headline, stacked top to bottom; omit them when there is no content, without changing the position of the headline. A divider spanning the full viewport width runs along the bottom edge of the hero.
en.mobile: The two columns stack vertically: the image is on top, spanning the full viewport width, flush with the top of the hero and both sides, still cropped to portrait; the headline, description and button sit below the image, horizontally centered with center-aligned text. The height becomes content-based and no longer fills one viewport. The divider along the bottom edge is kept. There is no motion.
